about_the_game:
★ Explore a vast facility, hop into combat vehicles to fire main cannons and machine guns, and ride around in carts, or just go on foot when you have to.
This is a retro-style 2D tank action shooting adventure game played from a top-down perspective.
Defeat mysterious AI-controlled enemies and find new vehicles to master in order to push deeper into the unknown.

★ Using the keyboard, the player controls their character and multiple units, moving them in the direction they're facing. It feels just like driving a remote-controlled car!

It takes a bit of getting used to, but once you do, it becomes effective and enjoyable.

★Get ready for a retro shooting adventure straight out of the '90s!

★ Story

Eldon Dallas is a brilliant engineer and a wealthy businessman.

He serves as the CEO of a weapons manufacturing company.

Lately, he has been staying alone in his personal storage facility, and all contact with him has been lost.

The facility is believed to house a large number of combat vehicles.

It is currently locked down by its security system.

Fortunately, a vehicle designated for facility use was found outside—likely with access permissions.

Now, you are sent to the facility to investigate and confirm Dallas’s safety.

★ key operations

【 car 】
・[W] : forward
・[S] : back
・[A] : steering wheel turn left
・[D] : steering wheel turn right

【 tank / human 】

・[W] : forward
・[S] : back
・[A] : turn left
・[D] : turn right

【 turret rotation 】
・[J] or [←] : turn left
・[L] or [→] : turn right

【 basis 】
・[space] : fire
・[Z] : get off, ride vehicle
・[C] : change weapons
・[H] : key operation reference of current vehicle
・[Esc] : pause, save, load
